title: Retargeting Ads: Why and How You Should Be Doing it (and Tools to Help)

facts.fact: The article was published on January 31, 2023 and is listed as a 10-minute read.
The page says retargeting works by using website cookies to anonymously track visitors and follow their movement around the internet so that ads can be targeted to them.
facts.quote: Using website cookies, companies are able to (anonymously) track visitors to their website, and then follow their movement around the internet

facts.fact: The page defines retargeting as showing ads to previous website visitors, and remarketing as collecting contact information from prospective customers in order to send them outbound marketing.
